answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a stake that is slashed on proven misbehavior, like a mesa that only stands if its base rock holds. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs real capital per identity, and the ridge of honest reputation grows only through verified work over time. A quill-signed audit trail ties every action to one stake, so an attacker must fund each fake separately instead of cloning one free identity.
